decisions.reason: Four years in, this injection unit serves a niche the firm knows well and costs little to keep listed and supported, so there is no clear evidence to justify giving up the option.
Its overlap with Product A makes it the more likely candidate for consolidation, but the lack of website observations in 2020-21 is not evidence of failure and holding it remains cheap.
Automatic airless guns are core components that share parts with the established range, so the cost of keeping them is minimal and their value is largely confirmed.
The multi-model air-assisted line gives the firm several variant options, and pruning individual models is more likely than abandoning the whole line.
Demand for digital monitoring of coating quality is growing, so the data logger's upside option is worth holding despite remaining uncertainty about its value.
